title: A more connected working day
disclosure: AI-generated fictional scenes and synthetic narration. Not footage of actual customers or employees.

lines.en: Every day, public organisations depend on people who keep buildings, spaces and services running.
lines.nl: Elke dag houden mensen gebouwen, werkplekken en diensten van publieke organisaties draaiend.
lines.pt: Todos os dias, há pessoas que mantêm os edifícios, os espaços e os serviços públicos a funcionar.

lines.en: But scattered emails, paper notes and separate lists can make even simple work harder.
lines.nl: Maar losse e-mails, notities en lijstjes maken zelfs eenvoudig werk ingewikkeld.
lines.pt: Mas e-mails dispersos, notas em papel e listas separadas complicam até as tarefas mais simples.

lines.en: Finding the latest information should not mean chasing another colleague, or another update.
lines.nl: Voor actuele informatie zou je niet steeds achter collega’s of nieuwe updates aan moeten.
lines.pt: Encontrar informação atualizada não devia exigir procurar um colega ou pedir mais uma atualização.

lines.en: LetShare for Gov brings everyday facilities work together, with a shared overview for your team.
lines.nl: LetShare4Gov brengt facilitair werk samen, met een gedeeld overzicht voor je team.
lines.pt: O LetShare4Gov reúne a gestão diária das instalações numa visão partilhada pela equipa.

lines.en: Book meeting rooms and workspaces, and see the reservations that shape your day.
lines.nl: Reserveer vergaderruimtes en werkplekken, en bekijk de reserveringen voor je dag.
lines.pt: Reserve salas de reunião e postos de trabalho, e consulte as reservas do dia.

lines.en: Report issues and plan building maintenance, so teams can see what needs attention.
lines.nl: Meld problemen en plan gebouwonderhoud, zodat teams zien wat aandacht nodig heeft.
lines.pt: Registe ocorrências e planeie a manutenção dos edifícios, para saber o que precisa de atenção.

lines.en: Register visitors and help your reception team prepare for the people arriving today.
lines.nl: Registreer bezoekers en help de receptie zich voor te bereiden op hun komst.
lines.pt: Registe visitantes e ajude a receção a preparar a chegada de quem vem hoje.

lines.en: Keep contracts and their documents organised, alongside the facilities work they support.
lines.nl: Houd contracten en documenten overzichtelijk, naast het facilitaire werk dat erbij hoort.
lines.pt: Organize os contratos e os seus documentos, a par da gestão das instalações.

lines.en: See open requests and recent activity, with the context to decide what comes next.
lines.nl: Bekijk open meldingen en recente activiteiten, en bepaal wat de volgende stap is.
lines.pt: Consulte os pedidos em aberto e a atividade recente, e decida qual é o próximo passo.

lines.en: Less time searching. More focus on the places, people and services your organisation supports.
lines.nl: Minder tijd kwijt aan zoeken. Meer aandacht voor de mensen, locaties en diensten van je organisatie.
lines.pt: Menos tempo a procurar. Mais atenção aos espaços, às pessoas e aos serviços da sua organização.

lines.en: LetShare for Gov. Book a demo and discover a more connected working day.
lines.nl: LetShare4Gov. Plan een demo en ontdek hoe je dagelijkse werk beter samenkomt.
lines.pt: LetShare4Gov. Marque uma demonstração e descubra um dia de trabalho mais conectado.
